headlines.title: Tech Earnings Are the Market’s Biggest Story This Week: Here’s Why Microsoft, Amazon, Intel, SanDisk, and Alphabet Will Drive the Stock Market’s Next Move
headlines.summary: This could be the most important week of 2026 for AI stocks. Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN), Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL), Intel (NASDAQ: INTC), and SanDisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) are preparing to report earnings, and the results could determine where the technology sector heads next. In this video, Eric Bleeker, CFA, Chief Investment Officer of 24/7 Wall St., previews the biggest earnings announcements and explains what investors should watch as concerns about artificial intelligence spending continue to pressure technology stocks. After sharp declines across AI infrastructure companies, Wall Street is increasingly questioning whether the hundreds of billions of dollars being invested in data centers will generate sufficient returns. Microsoft's Azure growth, Amazon Web Services' accelerating revenue, and Alphabet's expanding AI infrastructure investments will be especially important. Meanwhile, Intel, SanDisk, and SK Hynix could provide critical insight into demand for semiconductors, memory, and AI hardware. We'll break down earnings expectations, the most important numbers to watch, and why this week's results could either reignite enthusiasm for AI stocks or accelerate the selloff.

headlines.title: Chip Stocks Find Support Before Key Reports From Intel, Sandisk
headlines.summary: Chip stocks with third-quarter earnings reports due this week include Intel and Sandisk.

headlines.title: Can Sandisk (SNDK) Justify Its Price On Future Cash Flow?
headlines.summary: Sandisk has swung from a steep selloff in recent weeks to headline-grabbing gains over the past year, which puts a sharp spotlight on whether the current share price lines up with the cash the business can generate over time. The stock has surged about 601.5% over the past year, so a lot of future cash flow is already being treated as if it might show up.

headlines.title: SanDisk Stock Is Back on Wall Street’s Radar. Here’s Where I See It Going
headlines.summary: SanDisk just posted a record fiscal year yet sits nearly 50% below its 52-week high after a brutal month-long selloff. Whether that gap represents a rare opportunity or a warning sign depends entirely on one factor most analysts are overlooking.

headlines.title: SanDisk's report could reignite the AI trade — or signal a warning
headlines.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi previews SanDisk's (SNDK) earnings report, arguing that a strong result could steady a nervous tech market and revive the big stocks.

description: Sandisk Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells data storage devices and solutions using NAND flash technology in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, and internationally. The company provides solid state drives for desktop and notebook PCs, gaming consoles, and set top boxes; and flash-based embedded storage products for mobile phones, tablets, notebook PCs and other portable and wearable devices, automotive applications, Internet of Things, industrial, and connected home applications, as well as removable cards, universal serial bus drives, and wafers and components. It sells its products to computer manufacturers and original equipment manufacturers, datacenters, private cloud customers, cloud service providers, resellers, distributors, and retailers through its sales personnel, dealers, distributors, retailers, and subsidiaries. Sandisk Corporation was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Milpitas, California.
